comment: LHR retains precise clinical source — Existing provenance and versioning requirements are useful. These additions make semantic specificity, historical validity, and derived representations explicit rather than adding a duplicate record system.

public.text: LHR retains precise clinical source — Existing provenance and versioning requirements are useful. These additions make semantic specificity, historical validity, and derived representations explicit rather than adding a duplicate record system.
public.suggestedRevision: Append; retain Required status: Where ICD-11 is used, the LHR shall retain the source concept identifiers, applicable code-system release, complete coded expression, and required clinical context, together with the original clinical statement or a retrievable link to it. A derived statistical category or mapped code shall not overwrite the more detailed source representation. Links between source and derived representations shall be preserved.
